Thanks again for the time yesterday. As discussed, I wanted to kick off a short mutual action plan (MAP) and align on the technical evaluation timeline so we can reduce risk and aim for a timely close. I’ve attached a working MAP and our evaluation checklist to get us started.

High-level proposal (week-based):
- Week 1 (Jun 22–26): POC environment & SSO smoke test (Redwood dev env + test dataset)
- Week 2 (Jun 29–Jul 3): Integration & ingestion (sample ETL, streaming messages)
- Week 3 (Jul 6–10): Performance & quality validation (latency profiling, eval prompts)
- Week 4 (Jul 13–17): Final regression checks, summary, commercial close conversation

Success criteria we suggest you validate:
- Integration: sample payloads processed end-to-end without errors
- Latency: p95 response within agreed SLO for target profile
- Quality: pass predefined prompt set with no regressions vs baseline

Action items (owner):
- Priya / Arjun (Orion): confirm test account + sample data and Okta test tenant credentials

Attachments: Orion_MAP_v1.xlsx (editable MAP), redwood_eval_checklist.pdf (checklist & test cases)

Please confirm the timeline and who from your engineering team should be the primary technical contact — I’ve tentatively added Arjun (engineering lead) in the cc since he was mentioned. Hi Priya / Arjun —

Thanks for the notes — quick technical intro: I’m Hiro, Solutions Engineer at Redwood, and I’ll lead the integration work on our side. Short answers to the items Priya raised and a proposed, concrete set of next steps.

1) SSO (Okta):
- Redwood supports OIDC and SAML for both hosted and private deployments. For the POC we typically accept an Okta test tenant and standard assertion attributes (email, groups). I’ll send an example metadata file you can drop into your Okta org.

2) POC topology (recommended):
- Option A (fastest): Hosted POC in Redwood's cloud with IP allowlist — fastest to stand up and most straightforward for your engineering team.
- Option B (isolated): short-lived VPC peering / private deployment if your security team requires network separation. This adds ~3 business days for infra but is doable for evaluation.

I’ve attached a minimal network diagram for the hosted option (network_diagram.svg) and a checklist of the ports/allowlist we need.

3) SOC2 / logs / data retention:
- For the POC we can provide redactable request logs and a SOC2 summary package. Retention during POC is configurable (30 / 90 / 180 days); for evaluation we recommend 30 days unless you need otherwise. Nathan, if you could share the specific evidence items, we’ll coordinate.

Proposed technical schedule (dates are flexible):
- Jun 22: Kickoff + Okta test metadata exchange
- Jun 23–24: Stand up hosted POC + basic ingestion using sample dataset (we'll provide a small test harness)
- Jun 29–Jul 2: Run performance profiles and the evaluation checklist (we will capture latency percentiles and token-level cost estimates)
- Jul 6: Regression summary & handoff to procurement/commercial
\Owners and responsibilities:
- Redwood (Hiro): POC infra, test harness, run perf tests
- Redwood (Olga): project coordination, MAP updates, executive syncs
- Orion (Arjun): provide Okta metadata, sample dataset, security contacts
- Orion (Priya): final sign-off on success criteria

If that looks good I’ll drop the Okta metadata template and a small test harness repo link in the HubSpot deal and we can schedule the kickoff — I’m available Tue/Wed morning PT next week.
